coherence_issues.description: S1 states consolidated net profit of EUR 24.7 million for Q2 2026, while S5 states consolidated net income for Q2 2026 was EUR 79.0 million. These are fundamentally different figures presented as the same metric (net profit/income), creating an explicit contradiction.

candidate_sentences.text: During the second quarter of 2026, AS LHV Group reported a consolidated net profit of EUR 24.7 million, representing an increase of EUR 5 million compared to EUR 19.7 million in the first quarter of 2026, but a decrease compared to EUR 30.8 million in the second quarter of 2025.
Consolidated net income for Q2 2026 amounted to EUR 79.0 million, growing by 7.3% from EUR 73.7 million in Q1 2026 and rising slightly from EUR 73.9 million in Q2 2025.

details.coherence_justification: The summary contains a clear self-contradiction between S1 (consolidated net profit EUR 24.7 million) and S5 (consolidated net income EUR 79.0 million) for the same period Q2 2026. These represent different values for what appears to be the same financial metric, creating an irreconcilable internal inconsistency. While other metrics show logical progression (e.g., EPS, ROI trends), this fundamental contradiction undermines the overall coherence. The summary otherwise maintains reasonable organization with quarter-over-quarter comparisons, but the contradiction is severe enough to classify it as 'Not generally' coherent.
